# pf-web-poly-compile-helper-runner

This repository contains **pf-runner** plus supporting scripts, containers, and modular pf task definitions. The only root task file is `Pfyfile.pf`, which includes everything under `pf/`.

## Quick start

- Install (native only; container installer deprecated): `./install.sh`
- Read the task DSL + examples: `docs/QUICKSTART.md`
- Run tests: `bash run_test.sh` or `bash run_tests.sh`

## Docs

Project documentation lives in `docs/`.
